verdict.rationale: Kick documents no native scheduler. The closest evidence is event-triggered rules that "run automatically every time a matching transaction syncs." The AI docs also claim MCP/CLI lets you "automate month-end checks, and build workflows that run across every workspace," which implies recurring automation would rely on external tooling such as an MCP assistant or a cron-driven CLI. Missing for 10: a native schedule or cron for jobs and workflows, documented recurrence configuration, scheduled report delivery, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
